name: file_writev

ownership.argument: Astrolink needs F_FILE_WRITE(file, buf, n) to push a wake byte into the loop pipe. This build has no separate non-vector file_write: the binding shape has to become file_writev(file, iovec) (or nx_write(fd, buf, n)), which is a deliberate module-side change, not an address substitution.

provenance.source: Takes the file directly, rejects it unless the open flags at file+0 carry bit 1 (writable), reaches the inode through file+16, and dispatches the writev handler at inode_ops+40; when no writev handler is installed it falls back to the plain write path with a single iovec. Reached from 0xC1D25F4, which builds a one-element iovec from (buf, len) after fs_getfilep.

notes: Astrolink needs F_FILE_WRITE(file, buf, n) to push a wake byte into the loop pipe. This build has no separate non-vector file_write: the binding shape has to become file_writev(file, iovec) (or nx_write(fd, buf, n)), which is a deliberate module-side change, not an address substitution.
